promptingStudio.combinedPromptTemplate:
Scene: An investigative audio booth. Focused central presence with crisp low-mid body, designed for dry satirical analysis.
Sample Context: Deadpan, mock-serious, and methodical. Articulates absurd fictional damages with rigorous journalistic authority.

Speaker 1 - Satirical Investigator (Roger / Marcus):
Six utility poles, $800 each. He's destroyed a lot, and I do mean a lot of stuff. But how much worth of property damage has this maniac racked up over the years? And is it enough to bankrupt the entirety of Rhode Island? Let's find out, shall we? Never ever let Peter have anything even mildly dangerous. If he doesn't destroy it, he's going to destroy something else with it. But somehow people keep letting this guy be in charge of things. Like Jerome, for example, in the episode The Wolf of Wall Street, where he had to leave town to go take care of his mom, and unfortunately for him, he bumped into these guys on his way out.
